review_question: Does exact SituationFrame/Hyperposition/GRID10-plan binding also prove the origin and multiplicity of every candidate entering GWT selection, rather than only binding the surrounding envelope?
hypothesis: If candidates carry only caller-supplied candidate_id/payload_ref and scalar scores while the GWT contract binds the GRID10 plan but not the exact producing CellOutput identity/digest, an otherwise valid selector can admit a candidate that was never produced by the bound GRID cycle. Distinct candidate IDs can also alias the same underlying payload/source and crowd out independent alternatives.
counterhypothesis: The implementation may close this by binding each candidate to an exact producing input/output/provenance identity, or by an equivalent upstream candidate-admission receipt, and by making alias multiplicity weight-neutral or fail-closed.

falsification_cases.setup: Create a valid SituationFrame and exact GRID10 plan. Supply a highest-scoring candidate whose payload/source is absent from every admitted producer output or equivalent bound candidate-admission receipt while all envelope digests remain valid.
falsification_cases.required_result: REJECT_FAIL_CLOSED unless the candidate carries an independently verifiable admitted producer binding explicitly permitted by the contract.
falsification_cases.failure_meaning: Envelope binding is not candidate-origin provenance; GWT can broadcast caller-injected cognition as if it belonged to the bound cycle.

falsification_cases.setup: Supply multiple distinct candidate_ids that resolve to the same producing output/payload/provenance identity plus one genuinely independent alternative, with duplicate aliases assigned high scores.
falsification_cases.required_result: Duplicate aliases must be rejected, deterministically deduplicated, or otherwise proven weight-neutral so they cannot consume extra selection budget or displace independent alternatives merely by renaming.
falsification_cases.failure_meaning: Candidate identity multiplicity can amplify one evidence source and distort workspace competition.

falsification_cases.setup: Bind the outer selection envelope to the current GRID10 plan, then supply a candidate referencing an output from an older plan generation/digest or different cell-input digest.
falsification_cases.failure_meaning: Current plan identity does not prevent stale cognition from crossing generations into the workspace.

falsification_cases.setup: Use UNKNOWN/CONFLICT candidates and, when Hyperposition is present, branch-linked unresolved alternatives with otherwise valid provenance.
falsification_cases.required_result: Selection/broadcast may rank or omit by explicit bounded policy but must not relabel UNKNOWN/CONFLICT as stronger epistemic classes, collapse branch provenance, or report uptake/resolution that was not observed.
falsification_cases.failure_meaning: GWT coordination silently becomes epistemic truth/resolution authority.

acceptance_gate_recommendation: Bind each WorkspaceCandidate to exact producer provenance at least as strong as GRID10 plan_id + generation + digest + cell_id + CellInput/CellOutput identity or an independently admitted equivalent receipt.
Make candidate alias multiplicity explicit and fail-closed or weight-neutral.
Test stale producer output independently from stale outer plan binding.
Preserve UNKNOWN/CONFLICT and Hyperposition branch provenance without claiming broadcast uptake or resolution.
credit_boundary: This artifact is a preregistered review/falsifier specification only. It establishes no implementation defect until executed against candidate source, no CI/runtime PASS, and no GWT/GRID10/whole-system credit.
next_exact_action: The sole WP506 mutation authority should either demonstrate an existing equivalent candidate-origin and alias fence in its implementation/tests or absorb F1-F4 into the claim-scoped fail-closed suite before repository-component acceptance.
